content.hypothesis: Prioritizing navigation to an open surface receptacle first avoids the overhead of opening closed storage receptacles, yielding faster target acquisition when the object may be resting on a visible surface.
content.realization_pattern: Navigate to an open surface receptacle from the room center, inspect for the target object type, and take it if found; otherwise abort local probe.
content.scope: ALFWorld pick-clean-then-place tasks where the target object type is known but not visible at room center, and open surface receptacles are available in the admissible action list.

content.hypothesis: Prioritizing navigation to a closed storage receptacle first, rather than an open surface, yields faster target acquisition for objects typically stored inside enclosed spaces like bathrooms.
content.realization_pattern: Select a closed storage receptacle from the visible list as the first navigation target instead of following strict observation order or prioritizing open surfaces; navigate to it, open it, inspect for the target object, acquire if present, otherwise close it and halt the local probe.
content.scope: ALFWorld pick-and-place tasks where the target object is not immediately visible at room center and closed storage receptacles are listed in the entry observation.

content.hypothesis: Prioritizing navigation to a closed storage receptacle first, rather than an open surface, yields faster target acquisition for objects typically stored inside enclosed containers like mugs.
content.realization_pattern: Navigate to a closed storage receptacle from the entry state, open it, inspect contents for the target object type, and take the object if present; otherwise halt the local probe.
content.scope: ALFWorld pick-clean-then-place tasks where the target object type is known but not visible at room center, and closed storage receptacles are available in the admissible action list.
